tools.name: search_disclosures
tools.description: Search receipt-linked US government financial disclosures: both chambers of Congress under the STOCK Act, plus executive-branch OGE filings (chamber 'executive', which holds the President's disclosures). Every row carries receipt.url, the government's own document for that row: a PDF page for House

tools.name: get_disclosure_history
tools.description: Every observed version of one disclosure, oldest first. The change stream is append-only, so an amendment supersedes rather than overwrites -- the before and after of a restated filing are both here, each with its own change block and receipt.url. restated=true means content changed after first publ

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List filers with official identity (congressional filers carry their Bioguide ID; executive-branch filers return null with an explanation — identifiers are never invented). tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Live coverage counts (rows, filers, per-source totals) measured from the serving views at request time.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Source freshness and bulk-snapshot health. This endpoint downgrades itself when its own arithmetic says stale — it never guesses green. When state is 'degraded', degraded_reasons names each cause with its measurement; sources[].index_reconciliation says whether the government's own index lists filin
